{{Top|leg}}
'''Micro-grenades''' were miniaturized [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] that were fired from [[Micro-grenade launcher/Legends|micro-grenade launchers]], such as the [[Model MGL-1]]. The grenades were smaller and less powerful than standard thrown grenades, however they did have the same basic function as their standard counterparts. For example, a micro [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenade]] dealt exploding shrapnel damage, a micro [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenade]] would deliver non-lethal [[Stun/Legends|stun]] damage, and a micro [[Ion grenade/Legends|ion grenade]] would deliver ionization damage to disable [[Droid/Legends|droids]].

Micro-grenades generally had a blast radius of approximately 3 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].
